Name: Aymeric's Unique Children for the Unique Children mods
Author: octopathtraversing
Description:
Given these are purely assets, language shouldn't matter much other than renaming the assets in the given language wanted, provided the three mods have language translations.

This was made months ago for myself by myself for the Unique Children mods to have Aymeric's children look more like himself and Ishgard's children. Yes, there are no hyur here, but I ran on the logic of if someone married the Elezen, they want Elezen children. Plus, I'd think Aymeric likely would contact an adoption agency within Ishgard if he did adopt children. At least, that is how I'd see it.

Anyhow, this entire folder is merely a set of assets to be stored within the unique children mods by Shaklin. [b]It is by itself not a mod but an[i] asset addition[/i] to a mod for Adaire99's modded character Aymeric de Borel from FFXIV.[/b]

You need to do some work installing them manually instead of simply extracting them.

[u][i]Please follow the instructions below to add them into the following mods:[/i][/u]
[b]Shaklin's Unique Children Mod[/b]
[b]Shaklin's Unique Children Talk Mod[/b]
[b]Xiaoleiwen's Immersive Family - A Children's Expansion Mod.[/b]

[center][size=4][b][u]INSTRUCTIONS FOR INSTALLING[/u][/b][/size][/center]-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[b][u]1.) First of all:[/u][/b] [i]get off this page and download Shaklin's Unique Children mod and Unique Children Talk mod before coming back here.[/i] Otherwise, all you will have downloaded from this mod page are a bunch of visual assets with nothing to do.

[b][u]2.) Optional:[/u][/b] Also download Xiaoleiwen's Immersive Family - A Children's Events Expansion for more child immersion at the cost of hearing Aymeric break character and call to Yoba for help. Among other things.

[b][u][size=3]3.)ACTUAL INSTRUCTIONS FOR INSTALLING THESE ASSETS INTO THE MODS YOU JUST DOWNLOADED AND EXTRACTED INTO YOUR MODS FOLDER:[/size]
[/u][/b]
[list=1]
[*][b]Double check those mods are installed and working.[/b]
[*]Download Aymeric's Unique Children Assets.
[*]Extract Aymeric's Unique children assets where you can see and work with them. Say, your desktop or a convenient folder.
[*]Find and open your mods folder for Stardew Valley. ﻿
[/list]
[left][b]i.e. for windows using steam:[/b] This PC/Local Disc (C:)/Program Files (x86)/Steam/steamapps/common/Stardew Valley/Mods

      5.Locate which mod you wish to insert these assets into first.


[b][u][size=3]4.)The Unique Children Mod by Shaklin:

[/size][/u][/b][list=1]
[*]Once you find the Unique Children mod, open it.
[*]Open the assets file. There should be two named files called Adopted and Natural.
[*]Open the extracted Aymeric file from this very mod page. You did download and extract it into a convenient place, didn't you?
[*]There should be three files within the Aymeric file: Natural, Adopted, and Portraits. For the Unique Children mod, you only need to deal with the Natural and Adopted files.
[*][u]DO NOT ADD THE NATURAL AND ADOPTED FILES THEMSELVES TO THE UNIQUE CHILDREN MOD. IT WILL NOT WORK[/u].
[*]Open the Natural file in the Unique Children mod.
[*]Make a new file and call it Aymeric. This will be the file Aymeric's children assets will go into for his natural children.
[*]Open the natural file in the full Aymeric file you downloaded. See the Baby and Toddler files in there? These are the files you need to copy and paste into the Aymeric file you just made within the Unique Children mod's natural file.
[*]Copy and paste the Baby and Toddler files into the newly made Aymeric file within the Unique Children mod.
[*]Back out of the Natural file for both the Unique Children mod and the Aymeric file.
[*]Go into the Adopted file for the Unique Children Mod. Do the same for the Aymeric file.
[*]As was done with the Natural file, make a new empty file and name it Aymeric.
[*]Go into the full Aymeric file's Adopted file and copy the Baby and Toddler file.
[*]Paste them both into the new empty Aymeric file within the Unique Children Mod's Adopted file.
[*]Close both files.
[*]CONGRATS. YOU'RE DONE FOR THE UNIQUE CHILDREN MOD'S ASSETS.
[/list]
[b][u][size=3]5.) The Unique Children Talk Mod by Shaklin:

[/size][/u][/b][list=1]
[*]Find the Unique Children Talk mod by Shaklin in your mod file for Stardew Valley.
[*]Open the assets file. Then open the Portraits file.
[*]Open the extracted Aymeric file from this very mod page.
[*]Now you're dealing with the Portraits file only.
[*]Open the file and highlight all the portraits within the file. Copy them.
[*]Paste them all into the Portraits file within the Unique Children Talk mod by Shaklin.
[*][b][u]BIG NOTE: All those portraits have default names assigned to the portraits:[/u][/b]

[/list][b]         Natural Boy - [/b]Esme[b]
         Natural Girl - [/b]Miette[b] 
         Adopted Girl - [/b]Senna[b]
         Adopted Boy - [/b]Florian 

DO NOT REMOVE THE _DARK_SEASON NOR _SEASON FROM THE FILE WHEN GIVING THEM YOUR PREFERRED NAMES. IT IS ALSO CASE-SENSITIVE, SO ENSURE EVERY LETTER IS HOW YOU WANT IT.

SAY Terrine and not terrine. or TROGDOR and not Trogdor.

Renamed, it should look as such:   Yourname_Spring or Yourname_Dark_Summer, for example.[b]

        [u]Make sure to rename these portraits the names you wish to give your unique children with Aymeric, otherwise they won't show up when you speak to them![/u]
[/b]
Finished renaming them to your heart's content? Close both files. Well, now you're done for the Unique Children Talk mod by Shaklin!

[size=3][b][u]6.) Immersive Family - A Children's Events Expansion by Xiaoleiwen
[/u][/b][/size][/left]
[list=1]
[*]This is the only one I'd recommend you plan ahead for, as you can only use a single boy and girl portrait set for it.
[*]Determine which set of kids you will have with Aymeric first.
[*]Locate the Immersive Family mod (Portrait Version) within your mods file for Stardew Valley.
[*]Open the [CP] Immersive Family file.
[*]Open the assets file.
[*]Open the Portraits file. See the Toddler and Toddler_Girl pictures. You are going to replace them.
[*]Delete them both.
[*]Open the extracted Aymeric file.
[*]Open the Portraits file.
[*]Choose the set of portraits for the boy and girl you wish to have with Aymeric, your favorite as unfortunately seasonals do not work with this mod.
[*]Copy those portrait sets and those portrait sets only.
[*]Paste those portrait sets within the Portraits file of the Immersive Family mod
[*]Rename that set Toddler and Toddler_Girl.
[*]Close both files.
[*]YOU ARE DONE INSTALLING THESE ASSETS NOW FOR ALL THREE MODS AND CAN FINALLY PLAY.
[/list]-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
